hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: Lee2019 participants and pairs of C3/C6 (independent of HS-Stroke; not of C3/C6). TCFormer and CBraMod have never been run on these data. EEGNet-8,2 / ShallowConvNet (C6) and TS+LR (C3a) outcomes on the same pairs are known; every cross-model comparison is descriptive.

R8-D_family_holm.TCFormer_es_minus_final: early stopping changes d (two-sided; C6 found a reduction)

R8-E1_single_test.CBraMod_probe_d: frozen-encoder linear-probe d > 0 (full C3 design, 8,640 pairs)

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: placebo, BA contrast, partner-arm probability, off-target change, early-stopping epochs, A/A; paired participant-level differences vs EEGNet / Shallow (C6) and TS+LR (C3a) on identical pairs; probe vs TS+LR (all C3 pairs) and vs EEGNet (C3b pairs)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold; all results reported whatever their sign

design.pairs_deep: R8 subset of the R7-C6 groups: one pair per participant x held-out run (216 pairs, 54 participants), the first C6 pair of class 1 + (run mod 2); arms A, B, C, E + A/A (1,080 arms per model); C6 train (240) / validation (60) sets, pair seeds and group seeds
design.pairs_probe: full C3 design: 8,640 pairs, base 300 + 1 row, placebo arms C / E per pair
design.TCFormer: official configs/tcformer.yaml model_kwargs; Adam 9e-4, betas (0.5, 0.999), wd 1e-3, linear-warmup (2) cosine per epoch, 100 epochs, batch 64; C6 inputs (4-40 Hz, 128 Hz, 4 s, per-trial channel z-score); no interaug
design.CBraMod: TUEG-pretrained checkpoint (HF weighting666/CBraMod @500543c, SHA-256 0792cb80...); official BCIC-IV-2a preprocessing (CAR, 0.3-40 Hz causal Butterworth-5, 200 Hz, /100); E2: official fine-tuning recipe (all_patch_reps head, AdamW 1e-4 / 5e-4, wd 5e-2, cosine per step, clip 1, label smoothing 0.1, 50 epochs, batch 64); E1: frozen backbone, avg-pooled 200-d embedding, per-arm standardisation + exact L2 logistic regression (C = 1)
design.read_outs: final epoch and minimum-validation-cross-entropy epoch (same run), as C6
design.CRN: within pair: initialisation, row-position permutation; within group: dropout / drop-path stream
design.contamination: CBraMod pretraining corpus = TUEG only (Temple University Hospital clinical EEG); Lee2019 (Korea University) is not in it. REVE rejected: its pretraining list includes Lee2019MI (and gated weights)

amendment_v1_1: implementation only, before any probe outcome: the v1 probe stopped BLOCKED ('probe Newton did not converge'); diagnostic on 1,440 fits (gradients only): 1.7 % stagnate at a floating-point floor (max|grad| 5e-10..8e-8) under backtracking, a tol-1e-7 refit converges in <= 9 steps and agrees to 9e-9 in probability. v1.1 accepts a stagnated fit only if max|grad| <= 1e-6 and counts them. Training code (seq_train, models_de, vendored models, de_plan) and plans unchanged; the TCFormer / CBraMod shards launched under v1 continue (their checkpoints carry the unchanged subset commitment).
